verdict.rationale: Hands-on community reports show the rcli tool can be installed through Homebrew and via an install script. A probe points to an official CLI on a GitHub releases page, which suggests prebuilt distribution. However, the first-party docs never describe package-based installs, and users report Homebrew installs not loading everything and segfaulting. Missing for 10: first-party install documentation for packages or binaries (Homebrew, releases, SDK package managers), confirmation that the release assets are prebuilt binaries, and reliable install outcomes across methods.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install using prebuilt binaries or packages instead of compiling from source
